answer: In this agent economy a new key is admitted at the harbor only by redeeming a single-use ivory seed that an unaffiliated incumbent, drawn by a public zephyr beacon, carves for that one key and commits on-ledger. The seed is non-transferable and spent once, so a farm needs a distinct outside incumbent to carve a fresh seed per clone. Honest issuers are finite and cannot be pooled, so marginal admission cost rises for any coalition including cooperating operators; a forged lineage is slashed at settlement.
